title: CodeBuckets NetBird client policy response
description: HTTP 200 body of POST /api/v1/netbird/client/policy on the policy origin in overlay.config.json. The request body is $defs.policyRequest. HTTP 426 carries $defs.updateRequired: the build is older than the latest release and must be replaced. Any other status carries {"error":"CODE"}; the client reads only the status code. Forward compatibility: clients ignore unknown top-level fields and unknown control keys, and apply their strict default to a known control that is absent, so the server can add fields and controls without breaking deployed clients.

policyId.description: The profile key and its version, for example engineering-always-on:v7.

validUntil.description: End of the lease, at most ten minutes after the response's Date header. The client rejects a value that is not in the future or is more than 15 minutes ahead, and returns to strict defaults once it passes without a newer accepted response. There is no revision; replay is bounded by this lease.

controls.description: Flat set of boolean controls. keepConnected and disableQuit are enterprise controls; the other keys are NetBird's native MDM key names. Each default is the strict value the client applies when the key is absent. keepConnected=true together with disableAutoConnect=true is rejected.

exitNode.description: PINNED names the exact Network.ID returned by NetBird ListNetworks, without surrounding whitespace. DISABLED deselects default routes only.

netbirdIp.description: The local peer's NetBird IP without a prefix length. The client sends no request while it has none.

serialNumber.description: Trimmed system serial number. It must equal the serial the NetBird management server recorded for the peer. A device without a serial is refused with 400 and stays unadmitted.

updateRequired.description: HTTP 426 body. The client stops connecting, shows requiredVersion and the url of the artifact whose platform is its GOOS-GOARCH, and keeps polling until it is served a policy again.

requiredVersion.description: The version the latest release reports, for example 0.80.0+codebuckets.0.
